response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering leadership, distributed systems experience, and a solid foundation in agentic AI tooling. However, their background lacks direct experience with fintech infrastructure, agentic AI systems in production (beyond MCP tooling), or large-scale team scaling in regulated environments. Their fintech-relevant roles (Optilyz) focus on marketing automation rather than financial systems.
strengths: Proven leadership in scaling engineering teams and establishing technical best practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD at RIDE Capital)
Hands-on experience with distributed systems and real-time data processing (e.g., Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, agentic workflows at re:cinq)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with fintech-specific domains (credit risk, payment flows, embedded finance) or regulatory compliance
Limited direct production experience with multi-agent AI systems beyond tooling/integration work
No clear track record of scaling engineering teams to 30+ people or operating in high-stakes commercial environments
